issuing_body: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
implementation_notes: The AI RMF 1.0 was released on January 26, 2023 following a consensus-driven, open, and collaborative process. A companion AI RMF Playbook, AI RMF Roadmap, and AI RMF Crosswalks are also available. NIST plans to revise the Framework after the community gains several years of experience and additional research is conducted.
